injury: PCL sprain in his right knee, aggravating a training-camp injury, Week 1 (Sep 8)

news.words: Rams WR Puka Nacua aggravated his summer knee injury Sunday night vs. the Lions and, while he still is going through additional testing, he is expected to be considered week to week, per sources.

McVay told reporters in his Monday news conference that Nacua has a PCL sprain and will be placed on injured reserve. McVay said the recurrence "is a little more significant" than the original injury.
McVay on Monday said Nacua's knee injury sustained against the Lions Sunday night was a PCL sprain that will land him on Injured Reserve (IR). As a result, Nacua will miss a minimum of four games.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Adam Grosbard, Orange County Register)
news.words: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Nacua (knee) has a "unique" injury that may require him to miss more than the required four games while on injured reserve. The team officially placed Nacua on IR on Wednesday.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Adam Schefter, ESPN)
news.words: Nacua could miss between five and seven weeks, depending on how quickly he recovers from a PCL sprain in his right knee, sources tell Adam Schefter of ESPN.

news.source: Ian Rapoport, NFL Network, on X
news.words: From @NFLGameDay: ... #Rams WR Puka Nacua (PCL) could remain on the sidelines until Week 9.
